english.title: Drive vehicle / vehicle and trailer no rear registration plate - registered after 30/09/38
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), drove a

(A)_[vehicle,]_
(B)_[vehicle and trailer,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), when the registration mark assigned to the vehicle by the Secretary of State under section 23(1) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994 was not fixed to the rear of the

(C)_[vehicle]_
(D)_[vehicle and trailer]_

in the manner prescribed by Regulation 5 of the Road Vehicles (Display of Registration Marks) Regulations 2001
english.legislation: Contrary to section 42(1) and (2) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994.

english.notes:

(ii) Regulation 5 applies to vehicles first registered on or after 1st October 1938.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - for wording see end of document.
